Name: Animated Eyeball Scarecrows
Author: dollynhoevida
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/YXlsZ4i.png[/img]﻿
[size=3]Their eyes forever cursed, the watchers never sleep, it appears that they have a strong dislike for crows... Be careful not to let any crows out in their sight!
[/size][img]https://i.imgur.com/2TX6iAE.png[/img]﻿
[size=3]This mod can be used to replace scarecrows with animated eye monsters, there is 6 colors and options for them to look left/right, works well with my other mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14060]AT - Eyeball Sprinklers[/url].  [/size]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/hNORhek.png[/img][center][size=3][url=https://elthen.itch.io/2d-pixel-art-flying-eye-monster]Flying Eye Monster sprite[/url]﻿ by [url=https://elthen.itch.io/]Elthen[/url] <3[/size][/center][img]https://i.imgur.com/n2YpLy5.png[/img]﻿
[center][size=3][b]1[/b]. Download this mod and Alternative Textures

[b]2[/b]. Drop everything in the mods folder

[b]3[/b]. Buy the paint bucket from Robin and use it on any scarecrow

[b]4[/b].  Enjoy!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/puE8kJD.png[/img] Buy me a [url=https://ko-fi.com/dollymods]coffee[/url] if you want to help me make more mods [img]https://i.imgur.com/puE8kJD.png[/img][/size][/center]
